newsitem.title: USA: National HealthCare LP in deal with Lenox.
newsitem.headline: National HealthCare LP in deal with Lenox.

text.p: National HealthCare LP said on Thursday it signed a long-term management contract with Lenox HealthCare for a 128-bed center in Carthage, Tenn.
With this 10-year contract in place, National HealthCare now operates 3,492 long-term health care center beds at 29 Tennessee locations.
National HealthCare also said it opened a new center in Columbia, S.C. Nationwide, the company operates 107 long-term health care centers with a total of 13,556 beds.
